title: Tenant Screening & Affordability Assessment

blueprintSignals.name: Rent-to-income ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: monthly rent divided by verified monthly gross income
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Only count income verified from a payroll or bank source

blueprintSignals.name: Rental payment history
blueprintSignals.definition: months of on-time rent payments from reporting agencies or landlord references
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Reporting is patchy, so absence is not evidence of a problem

blueprintSignals.name: Income stability
blueprintSignals.definition: months in the current role and income variance over 12 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Gig and seasonal work look unstable without being risky, so model them separately

blueprintSignals.name: Document authenticity
blueprintSignals.definition: forensic score for edits, template reuse and metadata mismatches
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: False alarms reject honest applicants, so route flagged files to a person

label: For "Tenant Screening & Affordability Assessment": Assess whether a rental applicant can afford a unit and is likely to pay and care for it, using verified income and history, in a fair and explainable way. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Outcomes are seen only for applicants who were accepted, so the model never learns about the rejected ones.
